test_title: PYST 03: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

 # : LQT :: AJM : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is,

Option 1) # = JRM, % = COP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2f38ef43092ed957ffd5539d496eaa8584d9f3e6cafaa7a29252cc140625f45.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3ebe7897f599d9c4437ea4f74b104c489546145bd1fde7c0410b1debd408caa.png] 

Option 2) # = JPT, % = CKR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e15d527ff2471f8bbee79c86aca354266e4636310a42204c4f8ca8a84559a4bc.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cba735842ba91ff42b2f45bf02f6bfac9ed2f7c42f9d7fec0f1ff0af79cdc09a.png] 

Option 3) # = JPR, % = CKO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07a159c6392f7a4ce9ca0e8b4d5fba8b1a8733c82cb0c4b3fe3c18e2e77c08cc.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/974ec2c66beac4c5fa64a52df302c24588d9ffecc56271732dae093a377ddb6e.png] 

**Here both the letter cetter-clusters follow the same logic.**

Option 4) # = JQM, % = CPK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d903440c11605e1012d1afb814bd12e2fb33d5c110a2db24bc6a589e044dbe08.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2f8701e745971e411477ac5206c4a35d200e3fb865501ada182a5bb0893d26f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
